title: Father's Day (Tuesday Poem)
notes: From Dusie/Rob McLennan packet (acceptedDate). Notes say published as Tuesday Poem ~June 23 — use research.pubDate for that. Cover = article screenshot (og:image was unrelated profile photo). IG blocked.

research.excerpt: The other of the other / is the sky and its sphere / of longing. // Kolaptō grew in reverse, / roamed dung-billed instead / of bildungsromaned, / raised in a house / with all its mirrors pointed inward / to reflect only their dark walls.
